# ArcherLab Chat
> Free real-time anonymous chat service that runs in a web browser without installation.

## About
ArcherLab Chat supports lobby conversations, user-created chat rooms, and one-to-one conversations from a browser.

## Features
- Real-time anonymous chat
- Lobby chat
- Public and private chat rooms
- One-to-one conversations
- Browser-based access without installation
